headline_marked: Belgium [[thrash USA 4-1]] to reach World Cup quarter-finals
headline: Belgium thrash USA 4-1 to reach World Cup quarter-finals
summary: A dominant performance by Belgium ends the co-hosts' World Cup journey, setting up a clash with Spain.
details: Belgium dismantled the United States 4-1 in a last-16 clash at Seattle's Lumen Field, ending the co-hosts' hopes of reaching their first quarter-final in 24 years.
Charles De Ketelaere led the charge with two goals, while Hans Vanaken and Romelu Lukaku added to the scoreline to secure the victory.
The US attempted a brief fightback with a deflected free-kick from Malik Tillman in the 31st-minute, but Belgium's dominance remained unchecked.
A critical error by US goalkeeper Matt Freese, who was dispossessed outside his penalty area, led to Belgium's third goal in the 57th minute.
The match was overshadowed by controversy surrounding striker Folarin Balogun, who played after FIFA suspended a one-game ban following lobbying by US President Donald Trump.
Despite the reprieve, Balogun remained largely anonymous throughout the match, while Belgium's football chiefs had unsuccessfully challenged his eligibility.
Belgium now advances to the quarter-finals, where they will face a high-stakes showdown against Spain.
caption:
Belgium ruthlessly ends the USA's World Cup dream with a 4-1 demolition.

Belgium dismantled the United States 4-1 in a last-16 clash at Seattle's Lumen Field, ending the co-hosts' hopes of reaching their first quarter-final in 24 years.

Charles De Ketelaere led the charge with two goals, while Hans Vanaken and Romelu Lukaku added to the scoreline to secure the victory.

The US attempted a brief fightback with a deflected free-kick from Malik Tillman in the 31st-minute, but Belgium's dominance remained unchecked.

A critical error by US goalkeeper Matt Freese, who was dispossessed outside his penalty area, led to Belgium's third goal in the 57th minute.

The match was overshadowed by controversy surrounding striker Folarin Balogun, who played after FIFA suspended a one-game ban following lobbying by US President Donald Trump.

Despite the reprieve, Balogun remained largely anonymous throughout the match, while Belgium's football chiefs had unsuccessfully challenged his eligibility.

Belgium now advances to the quarter-finals, where they will face a high-stakes showdown against Spain.

headline_marked: Tourism alert: [[All tourist centers closed]] in Bandarban
headline: Tourism alert: All tourist centers closed in Bandarban
summary: Authorities have announced the closure of all tourist spots in the hill district to ensure safety and security.
details: All tourist centers in Bandarban have been declared closed. The decision was made to prioritize the safety of visitors and local residents.
The closure affects all major attractions and sightseeing spots across the district.
Travelers are advised to avoid visiting the region until further notice.
Local authorities are monitoring the situation closely to determine when it will be safe to reopen the centers.
